verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents API access tokens for programmatic access (launchdarkly-docs-37) and ships both an official CLI (launchdarkly-docs-12/40, probe-5) and hosted MCP server (launchdarkly-docs-10/11/40, probe-4) that are built atop its REST API, demonstrating a documented, scriptable public API surface suitable for AI-native/agentic use. However, probes for canonical OpenAPI/swagger endpoints and llms.txt/docs.md all 404 (launchdarkly-probe-1/2/3), so a directly discoverable machine-readable API spec isn't confirmed in this pack. Missing for 10: a linked OpenAPI/REST API reference doc, and independent confirmation that the public API is fully documented beyond token setup.
